text.description_html:
TC931-BR Global Series Mini Spring Residential Door Closer

The Global TC931 Gibcloser is a great alternative for use on interior and light weight exterior door applications.

Mini Door Closer, for wood or metal doors. Can be used on gates, screen doors, storm doors and specialty applications.

Arm glides on the included protective slide plate that prevents marring to door surface. Adjustable closer tension for doors up to 150 lbs.

This compact closer is easy to install with just a phillips head screw driver.

TC931-BR Gibcloser Features and Specifications:

  • Adjustable closing tension
  • Maximum door size: 36 inches
  • Maximum door weight: 150 lbs
  • Spring tension: 3
  • Spring Housing: 4 1/2" High x 1" Wide
  • Arm Length: 5"
  • Dark Brown
  • UL Listed 24SO
  • Installs in minutes with just a Phillips Head screw driver
  • Comes packaged with a slide plate that screws into the door.
  • TC931 Installation Instructions (PDF)
